correctness.rationale: For F²x=x, connected-cycle Laplacian forces equal two-round firing totals; nonfixed orbits fire exactly once at each vertex. The complete 2x3 local chip/neighbor case table implies allowed phase words with no 000 or 111. A matching parity bijection gives formula (1), an exact matching trace gives formula (2), and positivity yields the endpoint counts. Eigenvalue dominance proves the conditional CLT and exact palindromy proves the mean. Direct finite exhaustive check n=3..9 covers 349,504 labelled states after rigorous proof that period-two state sites have ≤3 chips; independent polynomial checks n=3..150 passed. No reliance on finite testing for infinite quantifiers.

value.rationale: Chip mass is the conserved natural control parameter in parallel chip-firing, and the microscopic period-two regime on rings is an established object of study. Exact per-mass orbit populations and their parity-dependent cutoff clarify the finite-size boundary concealed by the known bulk interval. The closed all-n distribution and genuinely probabilistic Gaussian law give meaningful information not supplied by qualitative period classification or structural block language; no arbitrary parameter slices or routine isolated calculation are needed.
